# Dictionary of questions to compare

```{r}
question1s <- c("Q11", rep("Q13a", 6), rep("Q13b", 6), rep("Q13c", 6), rep("Q13d", 6), rep("Q13e", 6), rep("Q13f", 6), rep("Q13g", 6), rep("Q13h", 6), rep("Q13i", 6), rep("Q14a", 2), rep("Q14b", 2), rep("Q14c", 2), rep("Q14d", 2), "Q15a", "Q15b", "Q15c", rep("Q16a", 2), rep("Q16b", 2), rep("Q16c", 2), rep("Q16d", 2), rep("Q17", 3), rep("Q18", 4))
question2s <- c("Q1", rep(c("Q10", "Q11", "Q12", "Q1", "Q5", "Q2"), 9), rep(c("Q5", "Q3"), 4), rep("Q3", 3), rep(c("Q3", "Q1"), 4),"Q10", "Q11", "Q1", "Q10", "Q11", "Q1", "Q2")

question_dic_res <- data.frame(question1s, question2s)
```

```{r}
# when trying to cross reference one question (question1) by another grouping variable (question2) 

validation <- function(question1, question2, data){
  df <- data %>%
    transmute(
      response1 = .data[[question1]],
      response2 = .data[[question2]]
    ) %>%
    drop_na()
  
  comparison_res <- df %>%
    group_by(response1, response2) %>%
    summarize(counts = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    group_by(response2) %>%
    mutate(percent = counts / sum(counts) * 100) %>%
    ungroup()

  table_comparison <- table(df$response2, df$response1)
#table_hours
  test <- suppressWarnings(chisq.test(table_comparison))
  
  ggplot(comparison_res, aes(x = question1, y = percent, fill = question1)) +
    geom_col() +
    facet_wrap(~ question2) +
    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = "Percent of responses"
    ) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank()
    )
  
  if (test$p.value <= 0.05){
    significant <- TRUE
  }
  else {
    significant <- FALSE
  }
  return(c("question1", "question2", round(test$p.value, digits = 4), significant))
}
# validation(question1 = f_res_coalesced$Q11, question2 = f_res_coalesced$Q1, data = f_res_coalesced)
```

## Running Each Question

```{r}
res_results <- data.frame(
  Question1 = character(),
  Question2 = character(),
  P_value = numeric(),
  Significant = logical()
)

for (i in seq_len(nrow(question_dic_res))) {

  res_results[i, ] <- validation(
    question1 = question_dic_res$question1s[i],
    question2 = question_dic_res$question2s[i],
    data = f_res_coalesced
  )
}

res_results <- res_results %>%
  mutate(
    Adj_P = round(p.adjust(P_value, method = "BH"), digits = 4),
    Sig_Adj = Adj_P <= 0.05,
    Question1 = question_dic_res$question1s, 
    Question2 = question_dic_res$question2s
  ) 

```

# Directors/Residents

### First, we need to reformat our dataframes so that each question matches up despite having a different title within the survey

### Additionally, we will only select the questions in common with both groups

```{r}
common_qs_res <- c("Q1", "Q3", "Q8", "Q9", "Q10", "Q11", "Q12", "Q13a", "Q13b","Q13c","Q13d", "Q13e", "Q13f", "Q13g", "Q13h", "Q13i","Q14a" ,"Q14b", "Q14c" ,"Q14d", "Q15a" ,"Q15b" ,"Q15c",
"Q16a", "Q16b", "Q16c", "Q16d", "Q17",  "Q18",  "Q19",  "Q20a", "Q20b", "Q20c", "Q20d", "Q21", "Q22a", "Q22b","Q22c", "Q23a", "Q23b", "Q23c", "Q23d", "Q24a", "Q24b", "Q24c", "Q24d", "Q24e", "Q24f", "Q25",  "Q26",  "Q27", "role")
common_qs_dir <- c("Q2", "Q4", "Q7", "Q8", "Q9", "Q10", "Q11", "Q12a", "Q12b","Q12c","Q12d", "Q12e", "Q12f", "Q12g", "Q12h", "Q12i","Q13a" ,"Q13b", "Q13c" ,"Q13d", "Q14a" ,"Q14b" ,"Q14c",
"Q15a", "Q15b", "Q15c", "Q15d", "Q16",  "Q17",  "Q18",  "Q19a", "Q19b", "Q19c", "Q19d", "Q20", "Q22a", "Q22b","Q22c", "Q23a", "Q23b", "Q23c", "Q23d", "Q24a", "Q24b", "Q24c", "Q24d", "Q24e", "Q24f", "Q25",  "Q26",  "Q27", "role")

res_common <- f_res_coalesced %>%
  select(all_of(common_qs_res))

dir_common <- f_dir_coalesced %>%
  select(all_of(common_qs_dir)) %>%
  setNames(common_qs_res)
res_dir <- bind_rows(
  res_common,
  dir_common
)
```

## Group by "role" and conduct chi-squared tests again

```{r}
res_dir_results <- data.frame(
  Question1 = character(),
  Question2 = character(),
  P_value = numeric(),
  Significant = logical()
)

for (i in seq_len(ncol(res_dir)-1)) {

  res_dir_results[i, ] <- validation(
    question1 = colnames(res_dir)[i],
    question2 = colnames(res_dir)[52],
    data = res_dir
  )
}

res_dir_results <- res_dir_results %>%
  mutate(
    Adj_P = round(p.adjust(P_value, method = "BH"), digits = 4),
    Sig_Adj = Adj_P <= 0.05,
    Question1 = colnames(res_dir)[1:51], 
    Question2 = "role"
  ) 
```
